name: All Stackables to 200
description: Raise the stack size of every stackable item.

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_stackable_backup (entry INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, stackable SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: the undo, taken before anything is changed

sql.statement: INSERT IGNORE INTO yulon_stackable_backup (entry, stackable) SELECT entry, stackable FROM item_template WHERE stackable > 1;
sql.note: INSERT IGNORE so a second install never overwrites the ORIGINAL values with this mod's own
upstream ships one size, 200, and its undo; the backup above is taken first so Remove can put every stack size back exactly

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_stackable_backup (entry INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, stackable SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: so removing an install from before the backup existed still has a table to read (it holds nothing)

sql.statement: UPDATE item_template t JOIN yulon_stackable_backup b ON b.entry = t.entry SET t.stackable = b.stackable;

notes: The upstream Down script cannot restore the original stack sizes (it does not know them), so the backup table `yulon_stackable_backup` (same shape as Bigger Stacks on TBC/Vanilla/Tortoise) is filled before Up and put back after Down on Remove. Do not drop it by hand.
